# Code of conduct

VNext is for anyone who wants to tell a story. Wherever people meet around it (issues, discussions, pull requests), please:

- Be kind and patient, above all with people who are new: to VNext, to making games, or to English.
- Talk about the work, not the person, and disagree without putting anyone down.
- Welcome everyone, whatever their age, background, identity, body, beliefs or experience.

Not OK here: insults, slurs and personal attacks; harassment, threats or stalking; sexual remarks or pictures aimed at someone; posting someone's private details; spam; and pushing someone to keep talking after they've said no.

## If it happens

Email me at zsande.vnext@gmail.com, with links to what happened. I keep reports private. I may edit or remove what was posted, lock a thread, or block whoever broke this, for a while or for good, depending on what happened.
